The last two members of the family the undefined-variable change opened. php does not refuse a
read it cannot perform: `$o = null; $o->name` raises `Attempt to read property "name" on null`
and answers NULL, and `$o[0]` raises `Trying to access array offset on null`. elephc refused
both — `Property access requires an object or typed pointer` and `Cannot index non-array` — so
`$x->name` on a variable that was never assigned took the whole program down at compile time
where php prints two warnings and keeps running.
